In base \(b\),

\[
17_b = b+7
\]

and

\[
97_b = 9b+7.
\]

We need \(b+7 \mid 9b+7\). Rewrite:

\[
9b+7 = 9(b+7)-56.
\]

Thus \(b+7\) must divide \(56\). Since \(b>9\), we have

\[
b+7>16.
\]

The divisors of \(56\) greater than \(16\) are

\[
28,\ 56.
\]

So

\[
b+7=28 \implies b=21,
\]
\[
b+7=56 \implies b=49.
\]

Their sum is

\[
21+49=70.
\]

\[
\boxed{70}
\]
